# Igris 2.0.3

Igris now uses QStash with database-backed Core recovery for reminders, due tasks, monitoring and briefings. Cloudflare execution is retired. Missed reminders produce a catch-up summary, and failed push delivery retains diagnostic information with bounded retries.

- Ask ?brief everything? or ?what remaining today to do? for fresh Wellvell information, overdue/today/upcoming tasks, and every project's health. Cached business facts and stale checks remain explicitly labelled.
- Schedule multiple morning/evening briefings by IST time and weekday. Open Briefing ? Call Igris for a spoken briefing and verified conversational task, meeting, note and memory actions.
- Android source includes incoming briefing invitations, native offline reminder/briefing alarms, shared local/push duplicate suppression, optional precise alarm permission, token-rotation retries and speech cancellation. Android signing and physical-phone acceptance remain pending; this public release contains the signed Windows installer only.
- Existing synced rich notes, provider/model routing, economy budgets, cooldowns and desktop window controls remain available.

Free Render can sleep or exhaust its runtime allowance. Backend recovery runs while awake and catches up after restart; timely server delivery during QStash outages requires an always-on host. Phone-local alarms cover downloaded schedules and remain subject to Android permissions and force-stop behavior. Durable attachment transfer and optional future external-write integrations remain outside this release.
